extracted.name: World's Best Key Lime Pie
extracted.description: Make and eat this delicious and easy pie within about an hour. Condensed milk, key lime juice and whipped topping are combined, poured into a graham cracker crust and chilled.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10 inch) prepared graham cracker pie crust
1 (16 ounce) package frozen whipped topping, thawed
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, mix together condensed milk and lime juice. Fold in whipped topping and mix until smooth. Pour mixture into graham cracker crust. Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.
